attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 13 streaming replication across the AlmaLinux 9 cluster: node1 as writable primary, node2 and node3 as read-only async standbys via pg_basebackup -R. Verified writes on the primary propagate to both standbys and that standbys reject writes. Completed the mandatory rolling-restart protocol (standbys first, primary last) with boot-id proof of each restart and confirmed replication/data recovery after each.
